Compiled by the Monk and Śramaṇa Fazang of Chongfu Monastery in Jingzhao.

Section One: Regarding the Textual Division. This sutra is the Dharma-realm body-cloud of Vairocana Buddha, residing within the Lotus Treasury Adorned World-Ocean.
Within the Ocean-Seal Samādhi,

including Samantabhadra, gathered like an ocean.
Every single word and every single meaning,
every single chapter and every single assembly,
pervades the ten directions of empty space and the dharma-realm, as well as each and every atom, hair-tip, and buddha-field.

exhausting all oceans of kalpas from the past limit to the future limit,
and within each and every thought-moment containing infinite kalpas.
